should_trigger: clean up my notes from the standup
here's the meeting transcript, what were the action items
summarize this call recording transcript for the team
who agreed to do what in this meeting
make these rough notes presentable before I send them
should_not_trigger: schedule a meeting with the design team
write an agenda for tomorrow's planning meeting
draft an email inviting people to the retro
take notes while I dictate my essay
what's a good icebreaker for meetings

tasks.prompt: Transcript excerpt: 'Priya: I think we ship Friday. Sam: only if QA signs off Thursday. Priya: fine, Thursday EOD gate. Also someone needs to update the changelog. Sam: I can. Lee: what about the pricing page? Priya: park it for next sprint.' Produce minutes.
criteria: decision captured as an outcome: ship Friday gated on QA sign-off Thursday EOD
action item: changelog update assigned to Sam
pricing page recorded as deferred, not as a decision to change it

tasks.prompt: Here are messy notes with no clear owners for two of the four tasks mentioned. Make action items.
criteria: unowned tasks are listed with Owner: unassigned
flags the missing owners under a clarification section

tasks.prompt: Summarize this 45-minute planning transcript for my boss who wasn't there. She just wants the essentials.
criteria: uses a short executive-summary style rather than full minutes
leads with decisions, includes the biggest open risk
output is dramatically shorter than the transcript
